verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents hosted, branded Universal Login for production sign-in (auth0-docs-85, auth0-docs-49) and a no-code visual editor for custom signup and login flows and UI (auth0-docs-86, auth0-docs-53), with per-organization branded login flows (auth0-docs-24). A community user also confirms using the Universal Login hosted page (auth0-comm-8-refresh-5bf7a5542b692fce). Profile management is thinly covered: progressive profiling only gathers user data on later logins (auth0-docs-84), and the pre-built white-labeled components are for B2B customer admins (auth0-docs-80), not end-user profiles. Missing for 10: documented end-user self-service profile management UI or components, embeddable framework UI components for sign-in and sign-up, and independent hands-on corroboration of customization depth.
